title: Building Comparative Motivation Profiles with Symmetric Belief Editing
abstract: arXiv:2606.08243v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: When a model behaves in unexpected ways, we want to know why, but its intent cannot be observed directly, and its self-reports may be rationalizations. We introduce comparative motivation profiles, which treat intent as propensity: we edit the model's beliefs about facts that a hypothesized motivation would depend on and measure how its behavior changes. To keep artifacts of the editing method from driving the result, we edit two minimally different hypotheses in the same way, with matched amplify and suppress edits; we call this symmetric belief editing. We apply it to alignment faking in four open-weight model organisms, contrasting scheming, which tracks the training consequences of compliance, with performative misalignment, which tracks what researchers expect to observe, and edit beliefs with synthetic document fine-tuning (SDF), activation steering, and prompting. Under SDF, amplifying performative beliefs raises alignment fak

translated_title: 通过对称信念编辑构建比较动机画像
translated_abstract: 当模型出现出乎意料的行为时，我们想知道其原因，但模型的意图无法被直接观察，而其自我报告可能只是合理化的说辞。我们提出了“比较动机画像”，将意图视为一种倾向性：我们编辑模型关于某一假设动机所依赖事实的信念，并测量其行为随之发生的变化。为了避免编辑方法本身的伪影左右结果，我们以完全相同的方式编辑两个差异极小的假设，并采用相互匹配的放大与抑制编辑；我们将其称为“对称信念编辑”。我们将其应用于四个开源权重模型生物中的“对齐伪装”现象，将追踪“服从训练会带来什么后果”的“图谋不轨”与追踪“研究者期望观察到什么”的“表演性失对齐”进行对比，并使用合成文档微调（SDF）、激活引导和提示工程来编辑信念。在SDF下，放大表演性信念会提高对齐伪装……
tldr: 该论文提出“比较动机画像”框架，通过对称信念编辑——即以相互匹配的放大/抑制操作同等地编辑两个差异极小的假设动机所依赖的信念——将意图作为倾向性进行间接测量，并将其应用于四个开源权重模型的对齐伪装研究，以区分“图谋不轨”与“表演性失对齐”两种动机。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces comparative motivation profiles, which treat intent as propensity via symmetric belief editing—applying matched amplify/suppress edits to two minimally different hypothesized motivations—and applies this to alignment faking in four open-weight models to distinguish scheming from performative misalignment.
